'''Ioaa''' was a sweet [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] found on [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]],<ref name="GCG" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE Ithor">{{CSWECite|II|123|Ithor}}</ref> The fruit once grew wild on Ithor's surface,<ref name="CSWE Ioaa">{{CSWECite|II|111|ioaa}}</ref> and some Ithorian [[Gender/Legends|females]] had "Ioaa" as a given name.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ioaa was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
